note: Fame-domain exclusion (spec/domains/07-fighter-content.md FX1, FX4). `domains` maps a domain to the words a kit may not use; `slots` is the domain each roster slot reserves whoever fills it (so a kit stays clean when a real-derived character takes the slot); `forbiddenStageTags` maps a domain to the stage tags its fighters may not fight on. Words match whole words after splitting camelCase and punctuation.
